Prashant kishor ki rajniti aur jan suraj ko lekar darbhanga ke brahman samaj ke logon ki kya ray hai? kya log PK ki rajnitik soch aur unke muddon se sahmat hain ya unke samne kuchh saval bhi hain? dekhie darbhanga se pablik opiniyan aur janie logon ne prashant kishor ki rajniti par kya-kya kaha.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
